analysis.session_summary: The dollar led all majors, gaining 0.541% against the basket, while VIX rose 0.997% and SPX fell 0.32%; EUR/USD lost 65.3 pips to 1.15868 and USD/JPY added 90.2 pips to 160.194. Most legs had no single identifiable catalyst, but the 16:00 Fed Warsh/Fed benchmark block accelerated the move, with Warsh's own USD impulse at 0.232% and EUR/USD dropping 18.3 pips. High-beta and European currencies underperformed: NZD -0.281%, CHF -0.234%, and USD/SEK +1.015%. The close left USD/JPY, USD/CHF, and USD/CAD within the top 0.90-0.99 of their daily ranges, signaling no mean reversion into the close.

themes.theme: Broad USD strength in a risk-off tape
themes.evidence: USD strength +0.541% vs majors; DXY +0.557% to 99.591; SPX -0.32% to 7714.3; VIX +0.997% to 16.85034; USD/JPY +90.2 pips to 160.194.
The 16:00 block 'Fed Chairman Warsh Speaks +3 more' recorded USD own impulse +0.232%; EUR/USD moved -18.3 pips, USD/SEK +284.2 pips, USD/ZAR +469.1 pips, USD/CHF +12.5 pips.
